simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מוֹשְׁכָה (H4189) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מוֹשְׁכָה (môwshᵉkâh) means something drawing , i.e. (figuratively) a cord First listed occurrence: Job 38 31.

definitions.full: H4189. moshekah or mosheketh [ משֶׁ֫כֶת ] noun feminine cord ; — only plural construct כְּסִיל משְׁכוֺת Job 38:31 the cords of Orion , i.e. probably those by which (according to some legend) he is dragged along in the sky (compare Di). מִשְׁכָּב see שׁכב . מִשְׁכָּן see שׁכן .
